metadata.basis: Representative engineering intake presets. Temperature and practical salinity are editable starting points informed by NOAA World Ocean Atlas/Copernicus climatology; TDS is rounded to nearest 1,000 mg/L from PSU as requested. Major-ion ratios use standard seawater except Caspian presets, which use the Peeters et al. (2000) Caspian major-ion distribution.
metadata.fouling_note: Default case fouling factor represents new/clean membranes and is preset by source water within 0.90-1.00. Hydraulic-envelope aged/fouled defaults are stored separately within 0.60-0.80. All values remain user editable.
metadata.degradation_model: Flow/Fouling Factor multiplies membrane A; Salt Passage Factor multiplies membrane B. No membrane-age field is used.
metadata.temperature_envelope_basis: Regional screening envelopes seeded from NOAA NCEI World Ocean Atlas 2023 temperature climatology (1991-2020 climate normals where applicable). Values are engineering starting points and must be verified against the project intake location and depth.
metadata.fouling_envelope_basis: CalcOsPower screening defaults: new membranes 0.90-1.00 A multiplier; aged/fouled membranes 0.60-0.80. User editable. Relative defaults preserve the source-water fouling ranking used by the legacy presets.
